page.overview:
Who is Boards?

Boards are a group of four ostensibly sentient Signposts that appear in Super Mario Galaxy. They are named Gil Board, Bill Board, Phil Board, and Jill Board respectively, and all of them teach Mario how to perform a certain move.

All four Boards have the same appearance as a regular wooden Signpost with a letter pinned to it. By extension, every Board has an identical appearance to one another. Jill Board is supposedly female, given her name, whereas the other three Boards all have a name generally given to males.

When talked to, every Board says "Hey!" before talking to Mario. Aside from being able to talk, Boards have little difference from regular Signposts. A few of them show up in multiple galaxies, namely Bill Board, but it is not shown whether they appear in several galaxies at once or travel between them accordingly. Given that several galaxies can be explored in a nonlinear order, galaxies with the same gimmick also feature the same Board, allowing Mario to learn about the gimmick regardless of which order he explores

Every Board has a name that is a pun of "billboard." They have a first name, followed by "Board." Bill Board is pronounced the same as billboard, but is still a pun because Bill is the first name.
